scope: P09/G09 typed legacy-memory semantics, bounded persistence, Unicode canonical tag compatibility, and central-v5 migration compatibility on the frozen tree
acceptance: All five legacy memory tools and migration compatibility pass.

toolchain.json: nlohmann-json 3.12.0#2 via the pinned vcpkg manifest

independent_checks: The builder and validator command records, stdout, and stderr were re-hashed. Both canonical commands ran from D:\GitHub\Forge-Conductor-Windows-Edition, exited 0 without timeout, emitted empty stderr, and each recorded digest matches its evidence file.

Each canonical run configured and freshly built x64 Debug, built x64 Release, passed two G09, five G08, two G07, four G06, four G05, and two G04 CTest entries in each configuration, and ended with 3,290 fail-closed assertions.

The G09 inventory is exactly two native executables with 14 cases per configuration: five application cases and nine Windows repository cases. The retained infrastructure executable runs exactly 52 cases, including three Windows NFC canonicalizer cases.

The typed service surface preserves exactly set, get, list, remove/delete, and search semantics. Purge, quick-check, and shutdown are management methods outside that five-operation count; P14 owns the eventual exact wire names and descriptors.

Raw request caps are applied before trimming or decoding. Tests cover key, body, tag collection, tag element, prefix, tag filter, query, and result bounds, plus deterministic U+0000 and malformed UTF-8 rejection without mutation.

Tag equality, deduplication, ordering, and filtering use bounded NFC UTF-8 keys while retaining the first original spelling. The final application service owns a shared immutable canonicalizer, the key factory revalidates UTF-8 and size, shared fakes apply the same policy, and a native test composes the real service, Windows NLS adapter, Windows repository, and Winsqlite store.

Default list/search visibility uses the source-compatible ASCII-insensitive SQLite LIKE predicate, while delete reports the exact case-sensitive system-key predicate. Tests retain the source post-limit tag filtering and visibility-only total-count quirks.

The immutable central-v5 fixture migrates through the P07 central-v6 path, preserves note bytes and timestamps, reopens idempotently, and retains representative agent-session, audit, and continuity-table sentinels. Hostile migrated tag JSON follows the source-compatible empty-list rule while oversized valid data fails integrity checks.

Confirmed purge is one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction that counts, deletes all normal and hidden legacy notes, verifies zero rows, inserts a content-free audit record with one injected non-fractional UTC timestamp, and commits. Wrong confirmation and injected failures leave notes and audit state unchanged.

The evaluated MSBuild guard queried seven P09 projects in Debug and Release. All 14 evaluations use SDK 10.0.26100.0, toolset v143, C++20, warnings-as-errors, no enabled CLRSupport or managed compilation, and no forbidden Forsetti-internal, Boost, Qt, Python, Electron, Node, or managed dependency in effective metadata.

The builder and validator independently produced the same 14 nonempty Debug/Release artifact SHA-256 hashes. The sealed Forsetti source remained exactly 171 files, 723,455 bytes, and tree hash cfc377fee173cddc515f18f9c28db58e10b468402a72541a1f0ad524a1073c28 before and after each run.
limitations: This approval is scoped to P09/G09 typed legacy-memory application and persistence behavior plus retained G04-G08 regressions. P14 still owns exact MCP registration, the five wire names, JSON Schemas, aliases, response envelopes, error mapping, request-level audit routing, and transport behavior; this report does not claim those surfaces are complete.

Production executable composition of LegacyMemoryService, WindowsUnicodeCanonicalizer, and WindowsLegacyMemoryRepository is intentionally deferred to the owning host/MCP composition phase. P09 proves real binary linkage and behavior through a native application-to-Windows-repository integration test, not a production host activation path.

P09 proves in-place compatibility for the source-compatible central-v5 store migrated through central-v6. Discovery, hostile-input admission, conflict policy, progress, and bulk import from an external macOS installation remain assigned to P23.

Windows NLS supplies the target NFC tables while Swift supplies its own Unicode implementation. Source-used canonical-equivalence, Hangul, compatibility-folding, embedded-NUL, malformed-input, bound, and BMP/supplementary ordering cases are pinned; broader cross-version Unicode corpus comparison remains a later full-parity/release activity.

Settings and CLI exposure for explicit reset/purge, installed-product data retention, packaging, performance profiling, endurance, and full product parity remain later phases and gates. Passing G09 is not a claim that the Windows port is complete.

failed_attempts.reason: An unrecorded pre-authoritative full run was manually interrupted after the retained Debug G06 CTest capture left ForgeConductor.Infrastructure.UnitTests idle for roughly ten minutes, versus its established 7-15 second runtime. The exact freshly built executable then passed all 52 cases directly from both the workspace and CTest working directory, isolated CTest passed, parallel G06 passed, a second complete unrecorded fresh-tree gate passed, and both authoritative fresh-tree records passed. No source defect or orphaned process reproduced, so no product code or retained G06 contract was changed.
